# Global Fuel Prices 2020–2026

## About the Dataset

This dataset, sourced from Kaggle (belbino/global-fuel-prices-20202026), provides a comprehensive weekly record of retail fuel prices across **84 countries** spanning **January 2020 to April 2026**. It contains **27,468 rows** and **10 columns**, covering petrol, diesel, and LPG prices normalized to USD per liter, alongside global Brent Crude oil benchmarks and national-level fiscal indicators (tax percentage and subsidy level).

The data was aggregated through a multi-stage ETL pipeline: extracted from global energy ministries, regulatory bodies (EIA, OPEC), and economic databases (World Bank); normalized from local currencies to USD using historical spot exchange rates; and aligned to a weekly frequency matching global crude oil reporting cycles.

## Column Schema

| Column Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | String | Weekly recording date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Covers Jan 2020 – Apr 2026. |
| `country` | String | Name of the sovereign state or territory. 84 unique countries. |
| `region` | String | Geographic region. Expected values include: Asia, Europe, North America, South America, Africa, Middle East, Oceania (7 regions). |
| `income_level` | String | Economic classification based on GNI per capita. Values: "High", "Middle", "Low". |
| `subsidy_level` | String | Degree of government intervention in fuel pricing. Values: "High", "Low". |
| `petrol_usd_liter` | Float | Retail price of petrol (gasoline) at the pump in USD per liter. |
| `diesel_usd_liter` | Float | Retail price of diesel at the pump in USD per liter. |
| `lpg_usd_liter` | Float | Retail price of Liquefied Petroleum Gas in USD per liter. |
| `brent_crude_usd` | Float | Global benchmark price for Brent Crude oil in USD per barrel. This is a market-level variable, not country-specific. |
| `tax_percentage` | Float | Estimated percentage of the retail price attributed to taxes. Values vary widely (observed range roughly 27–63% in sample rows). |

## Key Observations & Data Notes

- **Date column** is stored as a string and should be parsed to a proper date type for time series analysis.
- **Brent Crude** is a global benchmark and will share the same value across all countries for a given week. It can be used as a baseline to measure how much retail prices deviate from the international commodity price.
- **Tax percentage** appears to vary week-to-week even within the same country (e.g., United States shows values from 27.6% to 62.3% in the first five rows), which may reflect estimation methodology or compositional changes. Analysts should be aware of this variability.
- **Subsidy level** is a binary categorical variable (High/Low) and serves as a key segmentation axis for policy analysis.
- **Income level** has three categories (High, Middle, Low) and enables affordability and equity analyses.
- All price columns are already standardized to USD, removing the need for currency conversion.
- No explicit missing value indicators were noted in the metadata, but analysts should verify completeness across all 84 countries and the full date range.

## Analytical Context

The 2020–2026 period encompasses several major global energy events: the COVID-19 demand collapse (2020), the post-pandemic recovery and supply chain disruptions (2021), the energy price crisis linked to geopolitical tensions (2022), and subsequent market adjustments. This dataset is well-suited for analyzing how these shocks propagated from global crude markets to retail consumers across different economic and policy contexts.

def line_chart(series_list, width=980, height=360, y_label='USD/L', right_series=None, title=None):
    pad_l, pad_r, pad_t, pad_b = 58, 64, 24, 46
    plot_w, plot_h = width-pad_l-pad_r, height-pad_t-pad_b
    dates = series_list[0]['x']
    n = len(dates)
    def x_pos(i): return pad_l + (i/(n-1))*plot_w if n>1 else pad_l
    left_vals=[]
    for s in series_list:
        left_vals += list(s['y'])
    y_min, y_max = min(left_vals), max(left_vals)
    margin=(y_max-y_min)*0.08 or 1
    y_min-=margin; y_max+=margin
    right_vals=[]
    if right_series:
        right_vals=list(right_series['y'])
        r_min,r_max=min(right_vals),max(right_vals)
        r_margin=(r_max-r_min)*0.08 or 1
        r_min-=r_margin; r_max+=r_margin
    def y_pos(v): return pad_t + (y_max-v)/(y_max-y_min)*plot_h
    def ry_pos(v): return pad_t + (r_max-v)/(r_max-r_min)*plot_h
    parts=[f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" class="chart" role="img" aria-label="{esc(title or y_label)}">']
    parts.append(f'<rect x="0" y="0" width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white" rx="16"/>')
    # grid and y labels
    for j in range(5):
        val=y_min+(y_max-y_min)*j/4
        y=y_pos(val)
        parts.append(f'<line x1="{pad_l}" x2="{width-pad_r}" y1="{y:.1f}" y2="{y:.1f}" stroke="#e5e7eb"/>')
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l-10}" y="{y+4:.1f}" text-anchor="end" class="axis">{fmt(val,1)}</text>')
        if right_series:
            rv=r_min+(r_max-r_min)*j/4
            parts.append(f'<text x="{width-pad_r+10}" y="{y+4:.1f}" text-anchor="start" class="axis">{fmt(rv,0)}</text>')
    years = sorted(set(pd.to_datetime(dates).year))
    for yr in years:
        idx = next((i for i,d in enumerate(dates) if pd.Timestamp(d).year==yr), None)
        if idx is not None:
            x=x_pos(idx)
            parts.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{height-18}" text-anchor="middle" class="axis">{yr}</text>')
            parts.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#f1f5f9"/>')
    parts.append(f'<line x1="{pad_l}" x2="{width-pad_r}" y1="{height-pad_b}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#94a3b8"/>')
    parts.append(f'<line x1="{pad_l}" x2="{pad_l}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#94a3b8"/>')
    for s in series_list:
        pts=' '.join(f'{x_pos(i):.1f},{y_pos(v):.1f}' for i,v in enumerate(s['y']))
        parts.append(f'<polyline fill="none" stroke="{s["color"]}" stroke-width="2.6" points="{pts}"/>')
    if right_series:
        pts=' '.join(f'{x_pos(i):.1f},{ry_pos(v):.1f}' for i,v in enumerate(right_series['y']))
        parts.append(f'<polyline fill="none" stroke="{right_series["color"]}" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-dasharray="6 5" points="{pts}"/>')
    # event markers
    for label, dt in [('COVID low', brent_min_row['date']), ('2022 peak', brent_max_row['date'])]:
        idx = int((pd.to_datetime(dates) == pd.Timestamp(dt)).argmax())
        x=x_pos(idx)
        parts.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 4" opacity="0.7"/>')
        parts.append(f'<text x="{x+5:.1f}" y="{pad_t+14}" class="marker">{label}</text>')
    # legends
    lx, ly = pad_l, 18
    for s in series_list + ([right_series] if right_series else []):
        parts.append(f'<rect x="{lx}" y="{ly-9}" width="22" height="4" fill="{s["color"]}" rx="2"/>')
        if s is right_series:
            parts.append(f'<text x="{lx+28}" y="{ly-5}" class="legend">{esc(s["name"])} (right axis)</text>')
        else:
            parts.append(f'<text x="{lx+28}" y="{ly-5}" class="legend">{esc(s["name"])}</text>')
        lx += 150 if s is not right_series else 190
    parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l}" y="{height-4}" class="axis">{esc(y_label)}</text>')
    if right_series:
        parts.append(f'<text x="{width-pad_r}" y="{height-4}" text-anchor="end" class="axis">Brent USD/bbl</text>')
    parts.append('</svg>')
    return ''.join(parts)

def bar_chart(rows, label_col, value_cols, names=None, colors=None, width=980, height=390, title='Bar chart', horizontal=True, suffix='', digits=2):
    colors = colors or palette
    names = names or value_cols
    pad_l, pad_r, pad_t, pad_b = 150, 34, 34, 42
    plot_w, plot_h = width-pad_l-pad_r, height-pad_t-pad_b
    vals=[]
    for _,r in rows.iterrows():
        for c in value_cols: vals.append(float(r[c]))

    parts=[f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" class="chart" role="img" aria-label="{esc(title)}"><rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white" rx="16"/>']

        parts.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#e5e7eb"/>')
        parts.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{height-18}" text-anchor="middle" class="axis">{fmt(v,digits)}</text>')
    group_h=plot_h/len(rows)
    bar_h=min(20, group_h/(len(value_cols)+0.7))
    for i,(_,r) in enumerate(rows.iterrows()):
        cy=pad_t + i*group_h + group_h/2
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l-12}" y="{cy+4:.1f}" text-anchor="end" class="axis label">{esc(r[label_col])}</text>')
        for k,c in enumerate(value_cols):

            w=v/maxv*plot_w
            parts.append(f'<rect x="{pad_l}" y="{y:.1f}" width="{w:.1f}" height="{bar_h-4:.1f}" fill="{colors[k%len(colors)]}" rx="4"/>')
            parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l+w+6:.1f}" y="{y+bar_h-7:.1f}" class="value">{fmt(v,digits)}{suffix}</text>')
    lx=pad_l

def heatmap_income_sub(rows, width=760, height=300):
    incomes=['Low','Middle','High']; subsidies=['Very High','High','Medium','Low']
    pivot=rows.pivot(index='income_level', columns='subsidy_level', values='petrol')
    vals=[pivot.loc[i,s] for i in incomes for s in subsidies if i in pivot.index and s in pivot.columns and pd.notna(pivot.loc[i,s])]
    vmin,vmax=min(vals),max(vals)
    pad_l,pad_t=110,46
    cell_w=(width-pad_l-20)/len(subsidies); cell_h=(height-pad_t-44)/len(incomes)
    def color(v):
        if pd.isna(v): return '#f1f5f9'
        t=(v-vmin)/(vmax-vmin) if vmax>vmin else 0
        # interpolate green -> amber -> red
        if t<0.5:
            a=t/0.5; c1=(5,150,105); c2=(245,158,11)
        else:
            a=(t-0.5)/0.5; c1=(245,158,11); c2=(220,38,38)
        c=tuple(round(c1[i]+(c2[i]-c1[i])*a) for i in range(3))
        return '#%02x%02x%02x'%c
    parts=[f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" class="chart" role="img" aria-label="Income and subsidy petrol price heatmap"><rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white" rx="16"/>']
    for j,s in enumerate(subsidies):
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l+j*cell_w+cell_w/2:.1f}" y="28" text-anchor="middle" class="axis label">{esc(s)} subsidy</text>')
    for i,inc in enumerate(incomes):
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l-12}" y="{pad_t+i*cell_h+cell_h/2+5:.1f}" text-anchor="end" class="axis label">{esc(inc)} income</text>')
        for j,s in enumerate(subsidies):
            val = pivot.loc[inc,s] if inc in pivot.index and s in pivot.columns else np.nan
            x=pad_l+j*cell_w; y=pad_t+i*cell_h
            parts.append(f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{y:.1f}" width="{cell_w-5:.1f}" height="{cell_h-5:.1f}" fill="{color(val)}" rx="8"/>')
            txt='n/a' if pd.isna(val) else f'${val:.2f}'
            fill='#0f172a' if pd.isna(val) or val < (vmin+vmax)/1.75 else 'white'
            parts.append(f'<text x="{x+cell_w/2:.1f}" y="{y+cell_h/2+5:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" fill="{fill}" class="heatval">{txt}</text>')
    parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l}" y="{height-14}" class="axis">Cell values: average petrol price, USD/L</text>')
    parts.append('</svg>')
    return ''.join(parts)

def table(df_in, cols, headers=None, formatters=None, cls=''):
    headers=headers or cols
    formatters=formatters or {}
    out=[f'<table class="data-table {cls}"><thead><tr>']
    for h in headers: out.append(f'<th>{esc(h)}</th>')
    out.append('</tr></thead><tbody>')
    for _,r in df_in.iterrows():
        out.append('<tr>')
        for c in cols:
            v=r[c]
            if c in formatters: v=formatters[c](v)
            elif isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)): v=fmt(v,2)
            out.append(f'<td>{esc(v)}</td>')
        out.append('</tr>')
    out.append('</tbody></table>')
    return ''.join(out)

def line_chart(series_list, width=980, height=360, y_label='USD/L', right_series=None, title=None):
    pad_l, pad_r, pad_t, pad_b = 58, 64, 24, 46
    plot_w, plot_h = width-pad_l-pad_r, height-pad_t-pad_b
    dates = series_list[0]['x']
    n = len(dates)
    def x_pos(i): return pad_l + (i/(n-1))*plot_w if n>1 else pad_l
    left_vals=[]
    for s in series_list:
        left_vals += list(s['y'])
    y_min, y_max = min(left_vals), max(left_vals)
    margin=(y_max-y_min)*0.08 or 1
    y_min-=margin; y_max+=margin
    right_vals=[]
    if right_series:
        right_vals=list(right_series['y'])
        r_min,r_max=min(right_vals),max(right_vals)
        r_margin=(r_max-r_min)*0.08 or 1
        r_min-=r_margin; r_max+=r_margin
    def y_pos(v): return pad_t + (y_max-v)/(y_max-y_min)*plot_h
    def ry_pos(v): return pad_t + (r_max-v)/(r_max-r_min)*plot_h
    parts=[f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" class="chart" role="img" aria-label="{esc(title or y_label)}">']
    parts.append(f'<rect x="0" y="0" width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white" rx="16"/>')
    # grid and y labels
    for j in range(5):
        val=y_min+(y_max-y_min)*j/4
        y=y_pos(val)
        parts.append(f'<line x1="{pad_l}" x2="{width-pad_r}" y1="{y:.1f}" y2="{y:.1f}" stroke="#e5e7eb"/>')
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l-10}" y="{y+4:.1f}" text-anchor="end" class="axis">{fmt(val,1)}</text>')
        if right_series:
            rv=r_min+(r_max-r_min)*j/4
            parts.append(f'<text x="{width-pad_r+10}" y="{y+4:.1f}" text-anchor="start" class="axis">{fmt(rv,0)}</text>')
    years = sorted(set(pd.to_datetime(dates).year))
    for yr in years:
        idx = next((i for i,d in enumerate(dates) if pd.Timestamp(d).year==yr), None)
        if idx is not None:
            x=x_pos(idx)
            parts.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{height-18}" text-anchor="middle" class="axis">{yr}</text>')
            parts.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#f1f5f9"/>')
    parts.append(f'<line x1="{pad_l}" x2="{width-pad_r}" y1="{height-pad_b}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#94a3b8"/>')
    parts.append(f'<line x1="{pad_l}" x2="{pad_l}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#94a3b8"/>')
    for s in series_list:
        pts=' '.join(f'{x_pos(i):.1f},{y_pos(v):.1f}' for i,v in enumerate(s['y']))
        parts.append(f'<polyline fill="none" stroke="{s["color"]}" stroke-width="2.6" points="{pts}"/>')
    if right_series:
        pts=' '.join(f'{x_pos(i):.1f},{ry_pos(v):.1f}' for i,v in enumerate(right_series['y']))
        parts.append(f'<polyline fill="none" stroke="{right_series["color"]}" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-dasharray="6 5" points="{pts}"/>')
    # event markers
    for label, dt in [('COVID low', brent_min_row['date']), ('2022 peak', brent_max_row['date'])]:
        idx = int((pd.to_datetime(dates) == pd.Timestamp(dt)).argmax())
        x=x_pos(idx)
        parts.append(f'<line x1="{x:.1f}" x2="{x:.1f}" y1="{pad_t}" y2="{height-pad_b}" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4 4" opacity="0.7"/>')
        parts.append(f'<text x="{x+5:.1f}" y="{pad_t+14}" class="marker">{label}</text>')
    # legends
    lx, ly = pad_l, 18
    for s in series_list + ([right_series] if right_series else []):
        parts.append(f'<rect x="{lx}" y="{ly-9}" width="22" height="4" fill="{s["color"]}" rx="2"/>')
        if s is right_series:
            parts.append(f'<text x="{lx+28}" y="{ly-5}" class="legend">{esc(s["name"])} (right axis)</text>')
        else:
            parts.append(f'<text x="{lx+28}" y="{ly-5}" class="legend">{esc(s["name"])}</text>')
        lx += 150 if s is not right_series else 190
    parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l}" y="{height-4}" class="axis">{esc(y_label)}</text>')
    if right_series:
        parts.append(f'<text x="{width-pad_r}" y="{height-4}" text-anchor="end" class="axis">Brent USD/bbl</text>')
    parts.append('</svg>')
    return ''.join(parts)

def bar_chart(rows, label_col, value_cols, names=None, colors=None, width=980, height=390, title='Bar chart', horizontal=True, suffix='', digits=2):
    colors = colors or palette

    for _,r in rows.iterrows():

            parts.append(f'<rect x="{pad_l}" y="{y:.1f}" width="{w:.1f}" height="{bar_h-4:.1f}" fill="{colors[k%len(colors)]}" rx="4"/>')

def heatmap_income_sub(rows, width=760, height=300):
    incomes=['Low','Middle','High']; subsidies=['Very High','High','Medium','Low']
    pivot=rows.pivot(index='income_level', columns='subsidy_level', values='petrol')
    vals=[pivot.loc[i,s] for i in incomes for s in subsidies if i in pivot.index and s in pivot.columns and pd.notna(pivot.loc[i,s])]
    vmin,vmax=min(vals),max(vals)
    pad_l,pad_t=110,46
    cell_w=(width-pad_l-20)/len(subsidies); cell_h=(height-pad_t-44)/len(incomes)
    def color(v):
        if pd.isna(v): return '#f1f5f9'
        t=(v-vmin)/(vmax-vmin) if vmax>vmin else 0
        # interpolate green -> amber -> red
        if t<0.5:
            a=t/0.5; c1=(5,150,105); c2=(245,158,11)
        else:
            a=(t-0.5)/0.5; c1=(245,158,11); c2=(220,38,38)
        c=tuple(round(c1[i]+(c2[i]-c1[i])*a) for i in range(3))
        return '#%02x%02x%02x'%c
    parts=[f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" class="chart" role="img" aria-label="Income and subsidy petrol price heatmap"><rect width="{width}" height="{height}" fill="white" rx="16"/>']
    for j,s in enumerate(subsidies):
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l+j*cell_w+cell_w/2:.1f}" y="28" text-anchor="middle" class="axis label">{esc(s)} subsidy</text>')
    for i,inc in enumerate(incomes):
        parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l-12}" y="{pad_t+i*cell_h+cell_h/2+5:.1f}" text-anchor="end" class="axis label">{esc(inc)} income</text>')
        for j,s in enumerate(subsidies):
            val = pivot.loc[inc,s] if inc in pivot.index and s in pivot.columns else np.nan
            x=pad_l+j*cell_w; y=pad_t+i*cell_h
            parts.append(f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{y:.1f}" width="{cell_w-5:.1f}" height="{cell_h-5:.1f}" fill="{color(val)}" rx="8"/>')
            txt='n/a' if pd.isna(val) else f'${val:.2f}'
            fill='#0f172a' if pd.isna(val) or val < (vmin+vmax)/1.75 else 'white'
            parts.append(f'<text x="{x+cell_w/2:.1f}" y="{y+cell_h/2+5:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" fill="{fill}" class="heatval">{txt}</text>')
    parts.append(f'<text x="{pad_l}" y="{height-14}" class="axis">Cell values: average petrol price, USD/L</text>')
    parts.append('</svg>')
    return ''.join(parts)

      <div>{pass_svg}</div>

    <h2>Key Findings & Policy Implications</h2>
    <p class="section-lead">The evidence points to strong global crude pass-through, substantial regional price inequality, and materially lower price levels and pass-through in subsidized regimes. Policy design should focus on targeted dampening rather than broad untargeted price suppression.</p>
    <ol class="findings">
      <li><strong>Crude movements dominate temporal retail trends.</strong> Weekly Brent-to-retail correlations are {weekly_corr_petrol:.3f} for petrol, {weekly_corr_diesel:.3f} for diesel, and {weekly_corr_lpg:.3f} for LPG. Price stabilization rules should therefore be calibrated to explicit Brent movement triggers.</li>
      <li><strong>COVID and 2022 shocks transmitted almost one-for-one in global averages.</strong> During the 2020 trough, Brent declined {pct(covid_brent_drop)} and petrol declined {pct(covid_petrol_drop)}; from trough to 2022 peak, Brent rose {pct(rebound_brent)} and petrol rose {pct(rebound_petrol)}. Automatic smoothing mechanisms would have been most valuable during these two intervals.</li>
      <li><strong>High subsidies materially dampened consumer prices and pass-through.</strong> High-subsidy petrol averaged ${fmt(sub_idx.loc['High','petrol'],2)}/L versus ${fmt(sub_idx.loc['Low','petrol'],2)}/L under Low subsidies, and the Brent-to-petrol slope was {fmt(slope_reduction,1)}% lower. Regional benchmarking can help identify where retail prices reflect policy choices more than commodity costs.</li>
      <li><strong>Affordability analysis requires additional household data.</strong> High-income countries show the highest nominal prices and taxes, but `data.csv` lacks income, expenditure, or purchasing-power-adjusted consumption data. For equity targeting, combine this price dataset with household fuel expenditure shares before redesigning subsidies.</li>
    </ol>
